ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% low-intensity (dark) to 35% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixel ratio across visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, roughly symmetrical high-intensity (white) blobs located on the central-distal portions of each lobe, framed by a dark low-intensity perimeter and separated by a dark vertical median band.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary showing low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations; a specific irregular indentation is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad concave curve along the trailing edges, transitioning to a convex sweep at the extreme distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, high-intensity textured pixels at the extreme left and right lobe tips, indicative of rugose surface growth.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: At least three distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the white pigment field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biofouling or barnacle colonization visible as high-relief clusters at both lobe tips; distinct parallel rake marks on the right ventral lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly jagged and irregular 'fractal' boundary between the dark pigmentation of the fluke center and the white lateral pigment patches.
